@graph.name: C-CDA R2.1 XML
@graph.description: The Cascade Bridge Adapter for C-CDA R2.1 XML: the package of data a Cascade Bridge runs to turn a C-CDA ClinicalDocument, as a patient portal hands one out, into Cascade records. Import-only. This crate is the adapter's manifest: a Bridge reads the root entity first, for the format id, the source media type, the source schema, the envelope, the detect rule, the document table query, the mappings and the findings queries, the concept maps, the profile the Bridge must offer, the vocabulary repository and the paths, in it, of the ontology and shapes files the adapter is read against, the gap scheme every finding takes its body from, each gap declaring the sh:resultSeverity its findings carry where that is not sh:Info, the source accounting, and the test manifest. The data entities carry provenance for every committed file, and a sha256 computed locally over the committed bytes of each digested one. Seven inputs are copied byte for byte from the conformance repository's fixtures/ccda at the commit isBasedOn names; the others are authored here, and each says so.

@graph.name: Concept map: code systems
@graph.description: HL7 code system OIDs to the URI FHIR names each code system by, from HL7 Terminology's naming systems, read on 2026-10-07; the OIDs are those cascade-cli's src/lib/ccda-converter/code-systems.ts lists, and, added on 2026-10-29, the rows of cascade-vocabulary's system table (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/290: ICD-9-CM's other three OIDs, HCPCS Level II, ICD-10-PCS and CDT, read in HL7/UTG at 777bba6 and on terminology.hl7.org) and HL7 ObservationInterpretation (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/298); a code in a system the table does not list is typed urn:oid: and its OID. The stems are cascade-vocabulary's registry (https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/111), transcribed on 2026-10-10 and HL7 Terminology's where it states one (SNOMED CT's from SNOMEDCT.html, LOINC's iri-stem from v3-loinc.xml); NDC's is the 11-digit space cascade-vocabulary registers, the code normalised into it, since a C-CDA writes the 10-digit label code (https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/ndc.html, https://github.com/jayostis/cascade-vocabulary/issues/104).
